conditions.model: zero explicit diffusion geometry; no extracted layout

limitations: No transient-noise or mismatch run; kT/C is an analytical exercise, not noise visible in these deterministic traces.
Observed edge shift includes residual acquisition during the edge and model charge redistribution; it is not an isolated measurement of channel-charge injection.
Reference source R, package L, ESR and load pulse are assumed teaching parameters.
